parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The **ClientToken** value can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](~~25693~~).

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description:
The description of the security group. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length. It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

Default value: empty.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the security group. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group to which the security group belongs.

parameters.name: SecurityGroupName
parameters.description: The name of the security group. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and must start with a letter or a Chinese character. It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`. The name can contain characters that are categorized as letters in Unicode, including letters in English and Chinese, and digits. The name can also contain colons (:), underscores (_), periods (.), or hyphens (-).

parameters.name: SecurityGroupType
parameters.description:
The type of the security group. Valid values:

- normal: basic security group.
- enterprise: advanced security group. For more information, see [Overview of advanced security groups](~~120621~~).

Default value: normal.

parameters.name: ServiceManaged
parameters.description: This parameter is not publicly available.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The tags to add to the security group. Array length: 0 to 20.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description:
The tag key of the security group.

The tag key cannot be an empty string. The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description:
The tag value of the security group.

The tag value can be an empty string. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

sub_parameters.name: key
sub_parameters.description:
The tag key of the security group.

> To improve compatibility, use the Tag.N.Key parameter.

sub_parameters.name: value
sub_parameters.description:
The tag value of the security group.

> To improve compatibility, use the Tag.N.Value parameter.

parameters.name: VpcId
parameters.description: The ID of the VPC to which the security group belongs.
